title: rgba() values throughout NewStartPage sub-components
body: Many hardcoded rgba() values remain across the extracted sub-components (FeaturesSection, TabsSection, SimulationSection, CtaSection, etc.). E.g. rgba(14,165,233,0.2), rgba(168,85,247,0.2), rgba(255,255,255,0.8). These should be replaced with Tailwind bg-white/X classes or CSS custom properties for design system consistency. Run: grep -n 'rgba(' src/app/(frontend)/start/_components/NewStartPage/
rationale: Hardcoded rgba() values bypass the design token system and make theme changes difficult.

title: E2E test gaps — onboarding overlay and tab switching not covered
body: The existing test suite (tests/e2e/start-redesign.e2e.spec.ts) is missing: (1) onboarding overlay dismissal flow, (2) tab switching between dashboard/chat/notebook, (3) full simulation message exchange with multiple messages.
rationale: Review item 9 from the specialist review explicitly flagged missing E2E coverage.

title: onScrollToSimulation prop removed from NavigationBar — verify no dead links
body: NavigationBar previously accepted onScrollToSimulation prop but never used it (the nav has no scroll-to-simulation button). The prop was removed to fix a lint @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars error. If a future design adds such a button to the nav, the prop pattern should be restored from the prior handoff.
rationale: The prop was dead code — the scroll button is in HeroSection instead. Removing it fixed lint.
